name: Riferu
source:
[url=/c38946]Maria[/url]’s commanding officer. She’s something like Maria’s right-hand man.

Her angel powers are not as strong as Maria’s. Even so, she compensates for it with great effort, which is how she reached her current position. Maria has the utmost trust in her, and so they fight quite well together.

However, her personality is a bit too broad-minded as she has experience with many men. While her views differ from Maria in this respect, she still sincerely wishes for a good person to show up for Maria some day.

But… she falls for [url=/c38947]Alp[/url]’s trap. She becomes a succubus, her heart becomes perverted, and she indiscriminately rapes men and women.

Her character is now one of arrogance. She eagerly aims to defeat Maria.

Enormous breasts.

[Attempted translation of parts of [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=485545]Getchu[/url] description].
